label: Inputs and Outputs
subgoals: A function table lists inputs beside their outputs.
To fill a missing output, substitute the input into the rule and compute.
The same rule can be written as an equation, a table or a graph.

label: Finding the Rule
subgoals: Look for a constant difference or a constant multiplier between consecutive outputs.
A linear rule has equal steps in the output for equal steps in the input.
Test a candidate rule on at least two rows before trusting it.

label: Using a Table
subgoals: Tables are useful when the rule is unknown or when only selected values are needed.
Extrapolation continues the pattern beyond the table, but it is only reliable when the rule is known to continue.
Always state the units of the output and check that the table is consistent at both ends.
